title: Blowhorn - AI Native Social Media Management
registryDescription: Social media and marketing management for LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Hacker News, Bluesky, Slack, GitHub
shortDescription: Social media and marketing management from your AI agent: plan, draft, schedule, publish and track posts, replies and reposts on LinkedIn, X, Reddit, Hacker News, Bluesky and Slack; amplify on GitHub. Use the read-only hosted MCP or local macOS server; every change is a dry run until you confirm it.
longDescription:
Blowhorn is social media and marketing management for founders, DevRel and marketing teams, agencies and enterprises. Plan, draft, schedule, publish and track your posts, replies, comments and reposts on one shared calendar. Then bring your AI agent in through MCP. AI drafts, you decide.

Supported platforms today:
- LinkedIn, X, Reddit and Hacker News, through your own signed-in browser.
- Bluesky and Slack, through each platform's API with your own token or session.
- GitHub, for amplifying, following and starring (no publishing).
YouTube, Instagram and Facebook are coming soon.

There are two ways to connect.

Hosted server: any MCP client can connect over the web at https://mcp.blowhorn.ai/mcp. You sign in with your Blowhorn account through OAuth, and clients register themselves, so there are no keys to copy. It is read-only today, with four tools: getConnections, getEvents, getContentItem and listContentItems. Use it to let an agent see your connected profiles, your activity and your content from wherever it runs.

Local server: the Blowhorn desktop app for macOS includes a local stdio MCP server. It offers one tool per Blowhorn command, in the groups Act, Manage, Connect, Run, Observe and Meta. Through it an agent can draft, queue, schedule and check activities. You stay in command:
- Every tool that changes state runs as a dry run unless you confirm it.
- Approval mode applies to agents, so their work waits for a person to approve it.
- Riskier tools stay hidden until you opt in with --allow-hidden-tool.
- Results never include secrets, and tool arguments are never logged.
Requires Blowhorn 1.61.0 or later.

Not a bot. It's you. Blowhorn acts through your own profiles, on your own computers, at a human pace and within the rules of engagement you set.
